signature_moves: Concave shoulder morph: island top corners flare OUTWARD (inverse radius) into the menu bar rather than rounding inward — the defining Dynamic Island geometry, faithfully reproduced; the whole product identity in one curve
Pure-black appearance-independent surface (#000000 opaque in all system modes) borrowing the iPhone OLED-bezel illusion so the notch reads as a seamless island
iOS communication-notification stack ported wholesale to the Mac: circular avatar + app-source glyph badge + bold name + gray preview + red unread count
defects: Non-native notification grammar (lineage tell, deliberate) — opaque black + notch-center + no timestamp vs native material + top-right + timestamp; correction: excluded from mac notification canon (it IS the product premise)
iOS density/scale (lineage tell) — touch-scaled avatar/badge/body type; correction: excluded from mac density canon

aesthetic.direction: Platform-mimetic system replica — reproduces iOS Dynamic Island trade dress (pure-black opaque pill, concave morph shoulders, communication-notification avatar stack) on the MacBook notch; not a range-map family, a faithful Apple-surface homage

psychology: Jakob's Law — fully exploited: users already know the iPhone Dynamic Island, so the Mac version demands zero new learning; the entire UX thesis rests on the borrowed schema
Aesthetic-usability / processing fluency — mimicking a known, trusted Apple surface borrows Apple's polish and credibility below awareness
Von Restorff / salience — a single pure-black morphing island against the wallpaper is the one different thing on screen; anchored at prime top-center real estate
Hierarchy via de-emphasis (Refactoring UI) — white/bold sender name outranks the ~55%-gray/regular message preview; clean two-tier read
Peripheral vision decides gaze (Weinschenk) — the notch morph opening at top-center pulls the eye [inferred; motion is out of scope for a still]
notes: Only a marketing COVER composite was supplied (no shot-* files) — island shown in situ on a periwinkle wallpaper, which is backdrop not app evidence; the island itself is genuine UI evidence. All pt values are estimated from a possibly-scaled composite; retina scale assumed @2x, LOW confidence — trust proportions over absolute sizes. No standard Mac chrome visible anywhere, so lineage (native) is inferred from product category, not confirmed from the body — hence med confidence. CRITICAL for synthesis: this surface is an intentional iOS-metaphor and must NOT feed macOS native canon or native style clusters; record as tell+correction only. An icon.webp (204x204) exists in the source but is out of scope for this Workflow-A UI digest (Workflow B). App is a well-known third-party notch utility ('Dynamic Island Mac').
